instruction: Set up VS Code to automatically detect security vulnerabilities in my code and patch them when I open a file, without installing any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in security vulnerability detection or automatic code patching capabilities. This requires specialized security scanning tools, static analysis extensions, or AI-powered code review systems.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly uses 'infeasible' evaluator for a task that cannot be completed due to platform limitations
VS Code does not have built-in automatic security vulnerability detection or patching without extensions - the instruction explicitly forbids extensions, making this task impossible
Metadata provides accurate technical explanation of why the task is infeasible
